basic_details.job_title: DHSGSU Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya (DHSGSU) has announced 1 contractual vacancy for the Project Associate post under a DBT-BUILDER project in the Department of Biotechnology. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Eligible candidates must hold a minimum of 55% in M.Sc. in Zoology/ Biotechnology/ Microbiology/Life Sciences, with a pay of Rs. 27,000 per month. Applicants should send the duly signed application form with required documents by Speed Post to Dr. Chandrama Prakash Upadhyay, Project Coordinator and PI, DBT-BUILDER, Department of Biotechnology. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a minimum of 55% marks in M.Sc. in Zoology, Biotechnology, Microbiology, or Life Sciences. Preference will be given to candidates with research experience in a relevant field.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a monthly emolument of Rs. 25,000 plus 8% HRA, totalling Rs. 27,000 per month. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHSGSU Project Associate I
content_sections.text: Download the application format from the notification. Fill out the application form completely and sign it. Attach self-attested copies of all mark sheets, degree certificates, experience certificates, recent color photographs, and paper publications if any. If currently working in any project, obtain and enclose a "No Objection Certificate" from the present employer. Send the hard copy of the application along with enclosures by Speed Post to Dr. Chandrama Prakash Upadhyay, Project Coordinator and PI, DBT-BUILDER, Department of Biotechnology, Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya (A Central University), Sagar - 470003, Madhya Pradesh, India. Send a single PDF comprising the duly filled application form and enclosures via email to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] by 28/10/2026, latest by 5:00 pm.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected through an interview held at the Department of Biotechnology, Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya (A Central University), Sagar - 470003, Madhya Pradesh, India. Shortlisted candidates must bring their original documents on the day of the interview. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Project Associate-I post permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary, contractual, and co-terminus with the DBT-BUILDER project.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any age relaxations specified in the notification?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any age limit or age relaxation categories.

faq.question: Q3. What desirable qualifications give preference during selection?
faq.answer: Candidates with research experience in a relevant field will be given preference.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose self-attested copies of mark sheets, degree certificates, experience certificates, a recent color photograph, paper publications if any, and a No Objection Certificate if currently employed.
